abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Excavate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the card on top of your deck. Put that card on top of your deck, or discard that card. This power can't be used if Sableye is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Disable
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

text.name: Electrode

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

text.name: Scizor

attacks.name: Special Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Special Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 40 more damage.

text.flavor: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

text.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Paralyze Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

text.flavor: The knobs on its poison sacs are pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

text.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 40 more damage.

text.flavor: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. His movements are like a ninja's.

text.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie bubbling sound for intimidation.

text.name: Castaway
effect: Search your deck for a Supporter card, a Pokémon Tool card, and a basic Energy card. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Celio's Network
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card (excluding Pokémon-ex), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Copycat
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, count the number of cards in your opponent's hand and draw that many cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Cessation Crystal
effect: Attach Cessation Crystal to 1 of your Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If the Pokémon Cessation Crystal is attached to is a Pokémon-ex, discard this card.
As long as Cessation Crystal is attached to an Active Pokémon, each player's Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't use any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

text.name: Crystal Beach
effect: Each Special Energy card that provides 2 or more Energy (both yours and your opponent's) now provides only 1 {Colorless} Energy. This isn't affected by any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Scott
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards in any combination of Supporter cards and Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Steven's Advice
effect: Draw a number of cards up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
If you have 7 or more cards (including this one) in your hand, you can't play this card.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Voltorb
text.flavor: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

text.name: Multi Energy
effect: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides {Colorless} Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

text.name: Roseanne's Research
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Metal Energy
effect: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {Metal}. Metal Energy provides {Metal} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
